body:
Same category as BRAWLPIT's own S424 fix (the piece that moves Elo wasn't connected to what gets reported), different manifestation: rl_train_packet.py's per-generation evaluation match/record_match_result (already built unlike BRAWLPIT's original gap) ran AFTER push_checkpoint, so every push carried the pre-evaluation inherited Elo. Confirmed live against the actual running Colab job's registry: 11/11 pushed checkpoints across 3 generations sat at exactly elo=1500. Fixed by reordering: evaluate first, push with the real current post-match Elo. Live-verified via a real 2-generation local run (bin/shank_server + bin/emily-bot, no mocks): gen 1 vs gen 0 moved elo 1500->1516/1484. Full python -m unittest suite (35 tests) green. Commit 1a58afb.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-60: fixed real bug where pushed registry checkpoint Elo always stayed 1500
